name: @classconnect/db
//optionalDependencies: PostgreSQL binaries for `npm run db:local`. Optional because they are platform-specific: npm fails a normal dependency outright when the platform does not match, which is what used to break the Linux install on Vercel. As optional dependencies the wrong-platform ones are skipped silently, and the deployed build — which never starts a database as a child process — is unaffected.
